title: Dynamic Form Builder
content: Build dynamic form generator. Schema: JSON definition of form fields. Field types: support all common input types. Validation: include validation rules in schema. Layout: define layout (grid, sections) in schema. Render: dynamically render form from schema. Submission: collect and format data based on schema. Custom components: support custom field types.

variants.simple: Generate forms from JSON schema configuration.
variants.detailed: Build dynamic form generator. Schema: JSON definition of form fields. Field types: support all common input types. Validation: include validation rules in schema. Layout: define layout (grid, sections) in schema. Render: dynamically render form from schema. Submission: collect and format data based on schema. Custom components: support custom field types.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive dynamic form generator from JSON schema. Schema structure: array of field definitions with type, name, label, validation, options, layout hints. Field types: text, email, password, number, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, date, file, phone, currency, rich text, custom. Validation in schema: required, min/max length, pattern (regex), min/max value, custom validators with error messages. Conditional logic: showWhen, hideWhen conditions in schema, field dependencies. Layout configuration: grid columns, sections with headers, fieldsets, inline groups, responsive breakpoints. Schema format: JSON Schema draft-7 compatible, or custom simpler format. Rendering engine: map schema to React components, support custom component registry for field types. Default values: include in schema, support computed defaults (today for date). Options for selects: static options in schema, or async function reference. Submission: collect form data matching schema structure, nested objects for grouped fields. Schema validation: validate schema itself before rendering, helpful error messages. Live preview: optional live preview of form while building. Schema storage: load schema from API, support versioning. Custom components: register custom field types with render function, integrate seamlessly. Form state: work with react-hook-form or similar, schema-driven validation. i18n: support for translatable labels and error messages. Accessibility: generated forms meet a11y requirements. Performance: lazy load complex field types, virtualize long forms.
